attr.title: Last Scenario
attr.desc: Turn-based RPG following Hilbert, a small-town boy who learns he descends from the legendary demon slayer Alexander and sets out to fulfill that destiny. Party-based battles with Spellcard magic, plus the Hex card minigame.
attr.desc_md:
Hilbert, a boy who lives in the small town of Whitelake, considers himself the town's hero, much to the disbelief of most of its residents. After doing some "heroic" tasks around town he meets a mysterious woman named Zawu, who informs him that he is in the lineage of the mighty demon slayer Alexander and is destined to follow in his footsteps. This knowledge inspires Hilbert to go out into the world and fulfill his destined fate.

Last Scenario is an RPG with turn-based battles. The party for battles can contain up to four members. Other than physically attacking and using items in battles, players can also use magic in the form of Spellcards.

There is also a minigame called Hex that can be played against certain people throughout the world. Hex is a card battle type game played on a hexagonal grid.
attr.inst: Download Last Scenario from https://site.scfworks.com/?page_id=8 and extract its contents (Game.rgssad, Audio, etc.) into the port's game folder, then launch.
